description: Five-part state tracker recognized by official Innovid Tag Assistant 1.1.5 on legacy Flashtalking servedby hosts. Numeric tuple fields and a nonempty impression identifier are template completeness advisories. The recognizer does not establish server rejection, event enumeration or session correctness.
